QuestInfo.name: [Ariant] Who Is Areda?
QuestInfo.1: Jano says Areda appeared suddenly one day and became queen. He's suspicious that she placed a spell on the Sultan. Areda insists she's from #bOrbis#k, so head there yourself to verify this so-called fact.
QuestInfo.2: You arrived in Orbis and asked Kriel the Fairy whether she knows a fairy called Areda.
QuestInfo.0: Hear about the current situation of Ariant from Jano, the leader of the Sand Bandits.

1.0: Welcome, traveler... Did you really go to #m222020000# and back? Ah, so this is the book from #p2040052#... Thank you very much. With this, I'll have enough stories to last a while.

yes.0: I can't help but envy you for being able to travel to far places like #m220000000# and even #m222020000#... I wonder when I'll be free of the queen's grasp... I dream of the day I can travel the world with my brother.

npc.0: If you go to #b#m260000000##k, please tell #b#p2101008##k to one day come to this library and personally return the book...

item.0: Have you not gone to #m222020000# yet? It's not close to here, so you should get moving.

lost.0: You dropped the book that you were supposed to give to #p2101008#. Fortunately, all books from #m222020000# are magically bound, so if any of them get lost, they return to the library.
